name: Latinx Therapy
one_liner: A directory of Latinx therapists across the US working in English, Spanish and Spanglish, with filters for immigration, DACA and LGBTQ needs.
best_for: Latinx people who want a culturally responsive therapist
People who want therapy in Spanish or Spanglish
Immigrants and DACA recipients looking for an informed therapist
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (press 2 for Spanish)
People who want the service itself to provide or bill therapy
short_description: Directory of Latinx therapists across the US. Free to search; members offer a free consultation and you pay the therapist directly.
long_description: Latinx Therapy is a directory and podcast, not a therapy provider. Its directory lists culturally responsive therapists across the US who work in English, Spanish and Spanglish, with filters for needs such as immigration, DACA, LGBTQ and out-of-pocket care, and it says all members offer a free consultation. Therapists set their own fees; many listings note sliding-scale or private-pay options, and therapy is arranged and paid directly with the therapist. The site recommends screening any therapist before you start.
patient_summary: You search Latinx Therapy's free directory for a Latinx therapist in your state, in English, Spanish or Spanglish, and book a free consultation with them. If you continue, you pay the therapist directly at their rates, which may include sliding-scale or insurance options. Latinx Therapy itself does not provide or bill therapy.

pricing.starting_price: Free to search; therapists set their own fees
pricing.notes: Directory is free to search. All listed members offer a free consultation. Fees are set by each therapist and paid to them; the site highlights sliding-scale and private-pay options.

privacy.notes: Privacy policy says the site uses cookies and remarketing (including Facebook) to show you ads on other sites after you visit. Deletion rights not stated. Therapy records are held by your therapist. No regulatory action found.

faqs.q: How much does Latinx Therapy cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Latinx Therapy before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Latinx Therapy replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Latinx Therapy connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Latinx Therapy?
faqs.a: Latinx Therapy is available on the web.
Bilingual directory; Telehealth and in-person; Cultural and identity filters.
